statuses.reviewing: taken by review/next_batch.py (a batch); back to todo after 6 h or --release
statuses.proposed: the AI reviewer proposed a decision; the user has not confirmed it
statuses.needs-user: (old) left for the user; next_batch.py takes it again and the AI decides it
statuses.decided: the decision is final (in decisions.jsonl); not applied to the outputs yet
statuses.applied: the decision is applied and published

flags.check-fail: an output failed the re-detect check
flags.point-past-ink: sharp output reaches past the keyshape further than the input does
flags.narrow-points: sharp output has mitre points narrower than 60 deg (never move the corner; round if the point grows the shape)
flags.lone-round-in-sharp: sharp output keeps a round corner with a curved side (the books: a lone round corner)
flags.no-room: a corner had no room for its band radius (reduced or kept as drawn: a small feature?)
flags.big-round-kept: a big round is kept as drawn in both outputs (could be a corner: big-round decision)
flags.new-contact: an output touches another stroke where the input did not
flags.round-past-ink: round output reaches past the keyshape further than the input does
